description: Source code for configuration loader in Playwright, including functions for loading, validating, and resolving configuration files, as well as defining configuration objects.

methods.name: defineConfig
methods.description: Creates a configuration object by merging multiple configs, marking that defineConfig was used.

methods.name: deserializeConfig
methods.description: Deserializes a serialized config object into a full internal config, optionally adding to the compilation cache.

methods.name: loadUserConfig
methods.description: Loads user configuration from a specified location, importing default exports if necessary.

methods.name: loadConfig
methods.description: Loads and validates the Playwright configuration, setting up ESM loader, TS config, and transform options.

methods.name: validateConfig
methods.description: Validates the structure and types of the configuration object.

methods.name: validateProject
methods.description: Validates the structure and types of a project configuration object.

methods.name: resolveConfigLocation
methods.description: Resolves the configuration file location based on input path or directory.

methods.name: resolveConfigFile
methods.description: Finds the configuration file within a directory by checking common extensions.

methods.name: loadConfigFromFile
methods.description: Loads configuration from a specified file, applying overrides.

methods.name: loadEmptyConfigForMergeReports
methods.description: Loads an empty configuration suitable for merging reports, without local config.
